name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Melody Bar & Grill is at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester), near LAX, since 1952.
Hours on the website: Mon–Fri 11 AM–1:30 AM, Sat–Sun 9 AM–1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call to confirm late night.
Happy hour is 3–6 PM every day.
Mon: half off burgers 11–3. Tue: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11–3. Fri: $3 sliders 11–3.
Every week: karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs.
Melody Rewards is free to join and gives 100 welcome points.
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.
Rewards: 250 pts free soft drink or Melody Fries, 500 pts $10 off your check, 1,000 pts free starter, 1,500 pts free entrée (up to $21.50).
One reward per visit, one prize per day, no stacking. Rewards are never free alcohol.
Your reward pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it.
Birthday bonus: +250 points once a year.
Refer a friend: +100 points after their first visit, and they get 100 welcome points.
Just Landed: 10% off your first order today with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours.
LAX crew get 10% off the check with a badge (dine-in).
Melody Approach is a free flying game. Its weekly boards reset every Monday.
Game rewards are in BETA and switched off for now, so the boards are for bragging rights.
When game rewards turn on, the weekly prize is Free Melody Fries.
Games: Melody Approach, Trivia, Sports Trivia, Truth or Dare, Melody Word, Melody Mix and the LA Scoreboard.
No app download needed. It opens in your phone's browser and you can add it to your home screen.
Order from your phone by picking your table, the bar, the patio or to go, then pay your server like normal.
Free parking is available, including a lot for people picking up travelers.
Walking from the LAX terminals takes about 15 minutes.
The app comes in 12 languages.
Takeout is available, and delivery goes through DoorDash.
Private events run 10–150 guests, and catering is available.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Mon–Fri 11 AM–1:30 AM and Sat–Sun 9 AM–1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late night.

qa.q: What time do you open on weekends?
qa.a: Saturday and Sunday we open at 9 AM, and we stay open until 1:30 AM. Call (310) 670-1994 if you want to confirm.

qa.q: What time does the kitchen close?
qa.a: I don't have the kitchen's closing time. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994 before a late-night visit.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: Melody Bar & Grill is at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045, in Westchester near LAX. Tap Directions in the app for a map.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: You can call us at (310) 670-1994. There's also a Call button in the app.

qa.q: Where do I park?
qa.a: We have free parking, including a free lot for people picking up travelers. Ask staff if you're unsure where to go.

qa.q: Can I walk here from LAX?
qa.a: Yes, it's about a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals. Melody is also about 5 minutes away by car.

qa.q: Are you close to the airport?
qa.a: Yes. Melody is 5 minutes from LAX and has been the closest bar to LAX since 1952.

qa.q: When is happy hour?
qa.a: Happy hour is 3–6 PM every day.

qa.q: What are the happy hour deals?
qa.a: Happy hour runs 3–6 daily. The website lists $8 well drinks and $1 off drafts. Ask your server for today's full list.

qa.q: What are the weekly specials?
qa.a: Mon: half off burgers 11–3. Tue: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11–3. Fri: $3 sliders 11–3. Happy hour is 3–6 every day.

qa.q: What is the Monday special?
qa.a: Mondays are half off burgers from 11 to 3.

qa.q: Do you have Taco Tuesday?
qa.a: Yes. Classic tacos are $4 each and elevated tacos are $6.99 each, and margaritas are $6 on Tuesdays. The tacos are 11 AM to midnight.

qa.q: What tacos are on Taco Tuesday?
qa.a: Classic $4: Chicken, Steak, Carnitas, Dockside Fish, Shrimp, Salmon, Avocado, Beyond and Vegan Carnitas. Elevated $6.99: Baja Shrimp Taco Melt, Smash Burger Taco and Sweet & Spicy Fried Chicken Taco.

qa.q: Can I order Taco Tuesday tacos on other days?
qa.a: No. The Taco Tuesday section is shown every day, but you can only add it to an order on Tuesdays.

qa.q: What is the Thursday special?
qa.a: Thursdays are half off sandwiches, 11–3.

qa.q: What is the Friday special?
qa.a: Fridays are $3 sliders, 11–3.

qa.q: Do you have live music or karaoke?
qa.a: Yes. Every week we have karaoke, live bands, DJs and trivia. Karaoke is on Wednesdays from about 10 PM. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm tonight.

qa.q: Can I watch the game at Melody?
qa.a: Yes, every game is on the TVs. The Sports tab shows live scores for LA and California teams and where to watch each game.

qa.q: Is there a cover charge?
qa.a: I don't have cover charge details for every event. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you take reservations?
qa.a: I don't have reservation details in the app. Please call (310) 670-1994 and ask.

qa.q: Can I host a private event or party?
qa.a: Yes. Private events run 10–150 guests, and catering is available. Call (310) 670-1994 for details.

qa.q: Do you do takeout or delivery?
qa.a: Takeout is available, and delivery goes through DoorDash. In the app you can pick To go when you order.

qa.q: What is Melody Rewards?
qa.a: It's our free rewards program. You earn points on every check and from games, and you carry your gold Melody Rewards card on your phone.

qa.q: How do I join Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Tap the join option in the app. It's free, takes about 10 seconds, and you get 100 welcome points.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No, joining is free. It's one account per person.

qa.q: How many points do I get for joining?
qa.a: You get 100 welcome points once, when you join.

qa.q: How many points do I earn per dollar?
qa.a: You earn 10 points for every $1 you spend on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get points for my check?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit in the app, then snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). Once Toast is connected this will be automatic.

qa.q: Is there a limit on points from one visit?
qa.a: You can claim one receipt per day, each check only once, up to $150 per check. Claims are checked against our sales report, and points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Do tax and tip earn points?
qa.a: No. You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases before tip. Ask staff about anything not eligible.

qa.q: Do I get double points at happy hour?
qa.a: The app doesn't list double points. You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases.

qa.q: Do my points work at other restaurants?
qa.a: No. Melody has its own points balance, and points don't move between restaurants.

qa.q: Do my points expire?
qa.a: I don't have expiry details. Points you've earned stay in your balance unless the program ends. Ask staff if you want more detail.

qa.q: What rewards can I get?
qa.a: 250 pts: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500 pts: $10 off your check. 1,000 pts: free starter. 1,500 pts: free entrée up to $21.50.

qa.q: How many points for free Melody Fries?
qa.a: 250 points gets you a free soft drink or Melody Fries.

qa.q: How many points for $10 off?
qa.a: 500 points gets you $10 off your check.

qa.q: Which starters can I get free?
qa.a: For 1,000 points you can pick a free Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers.

qa.q: What can I get for 1,500 points?
qa.a: A free entrée up to $21.50: any Mac & Cheese, Melody Burger, burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: How do I use a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it. Your next code comes on your next visit.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward per visit?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day, and rewards can't be stacked.

qa.q: Can I get alcohol as a reward?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: Can I give my reward to someone else?
qa.a: No. Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: What does 'Come back tomorrow' mean?
qa.a: You get one prize per day, whether it's a reward or a game prize. A second one shows 'Come back tomorrow', and your next prize is available the next day (Los Angeles date).

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: The app doesn't show membership levels. You collect points and trade them for the rewards.

qa.q: Do you have a birthday club?
qa.a: Yes. Members get +250 points once a year on their birthday.

qa.q: How do I refer a friend?
qa.a: Tap Text a friend on your member card to send your invite link. When your friend joins with your code and comes in, you get +100 points.

qa.q: What does my friend get?
qa.a: Your friend gets 100 welcome points when they join with your code.

qa.q: When do I get the referral points?
qa.a: Points pay once per friend, after their first visit.

qa.q: Can I enter a friend's code later?
qa.a: No. You can use one friend's code, entered once when you join. It can't be changed later, and you can't use your own.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for turning on location?
qa.a: Yes, a one-time +100 points. You need location and notifications on when you open the app on at least 3 different days spanning at least 7 days.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for leaving a review?
qa.a: Yes. You get +50 points once for telling us how we did in the app.

qa.q: What is Just Landed?
qa.a: If you landed at LAX in the last 24 hours, show your boarding pass to your server for 10% off your first order today. It's one per guest per day and can't be combined with other offers.

qa.q: Do you have an LAX worker discount?
qa.a: Yes. Airline, TSA, terminal, hotel, rental car and shuttle workers get 10% off the check with a badge or proof of employment. It's dine-in only and can't be combined with other promos.

qa.q: What is Melody Approach?
qa.a: It's our free arcade flying game over Los Angeles with two modes, Campaign and Survival. Play with or without an account.

qa.q: How do I control the plane?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and the plane glides to your finger. Tap ⚡ for a speed boost and grab the hourglass for slow-mo.

qa.q: What is Campaign mode?
qa.a: Campaign is 10 levels of about 45 seconds each, following a real SoCal route from Melody to Hollywood. There are six boss fights, and then you land back at LAX.

qa.q: What is Survival mode?
qa.a: Survival has no finish line. It keeps getting harder, and your time survived is what counts.

qa.q: How does scoring and health work in Melody Approach?
qa.a: You shoot down jets, UFOs, choppers and bosses, and you catch Melody's food and music notes. Three hits and your plane goes down, which ends the flight. Enemy attacks are always warned first.

qa.q: When do the guns turn on?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses unlocks stronger guns, and you refill ammo by catching ammo crates.

qa.q: Can I play without shooting?
qa.a: Yes. Pause and tap the ⚔️ button to switch to a calm flight with no combat.

qa.q: How often can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like, since the game is free. There's no purchase necessary.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: There are two weekly boards, Campaign (by score) and Survival (by longest time). Both reset every Monday. Practice and test flights don't go on the boards.

qa.q: How do I post my score?
qa.a: When your flight ends, tap Post my score on the end screen to put it on the board.

qa.q: Is there a weekly prize?
qa.a: The weekly prize shown in the game is Free Melody Fries for the top Campaign score and the longest Survival time. The game is in BETA and prizes switch on soon, so for now the boards are bragging rights only.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked?
qa.a: Both boards reset every Monday. Prizes are off during BETA, and I don't have details on how winners are contacted. Ask staff.

qa.q: Do I earn points from games?
qa.a: Not yet. Game rewards are in BETA and switched off. When they're on, Melody Approach gives 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 game points a day.

qa.q: What is the Games Pack?
qa.a: It has Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word, Melody Mix and Truth or Dare. You can play solo or pass the phone around the table.

qa.q: How does Trivia work?
qa.a: Pick a category and answer multiple-choice questions against a timer. Faster right answers score more. Solo is 10 questions, or you can pass the phone with 2–6 players.

qa.q: What is Sports Trivia?
qa.a: It's sports questions with a Fan Test. Pick your team for 10 questions and a 1–5 star Fan Rating, or play mixed LA sports.

qa.q: How does Melody Word work?
qa.a: It's one daily 5-letter word, the same for everyone that day. You get 6 guesses and up to 2 hints, and a new word comes every day at midnight LA time.

qa.q: How does Melody Mix work?
qa.a: It's a word scramble against the clock. Tap the letters to unscramble each word, and you get 3 skips.

qa.q: How does Truth or Dare work?
qa.a: Pick Truth or Dare for 1–6 players, with 3 turns each. Dares never involve drinking, and anyone can pass. It's just for fun, with no points.

qa.q: How many points can I earn from the Games Pack?
qa.a: When game rewards are on: Trivia and Sports Trivia give 1 point per 2 right answers (up to 5 a round), Melody Mix 1 per 2 words (up to 3), and Melody Word 3 points (2 with 1 hint, 1 with 2). The limit is 10 Games Pack points a day.

qa.q: What is the LA Scoreboard?
qa.a: It shows live scores for LA and California teams from ESPN, for information only with no streams. Tap a game for details and where to watch.

qa.q: What is 'Who wins?'
qa.a: It's a free, just-for-fun pick on today's games with no money or wagers. Picks lock when the game starts. When game rewards are on, a right pick earns 2 points, up to 6 a day.

qa.q: Can I order from my phone?
qa.a: Yes. Choose where you're sitting (your table, the bar, the patio or to go), add items and tap Send my order. You pay your server or bartender like normal.

qa.q: What if I scanned a table QR code?
qa.a: Then your table is already picked. You can also tap a table number from 1–20.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: Pay your server or bartender like normal. You still earn points on every check.

qa.q: What if I order To go?
qa.a: Pick To go in the app and we'll text you when it's ready.

qa.q: What food is on the menu?
qa.a: Starters, Mac & Cheese, the Melody Burger, Fries, Soups, Tacos & Burritos, plus Taco Tuesday specials. Open the Menu tab for photos, descriptions and prices.

qa.q: What starters do you have?
qa.a: Lemon Pepper Wings $16, Avocado Toast $13, BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites $15, Buttermilk Chicken Strips & Fries $16, Chicken Pot Stickers $15, Fried Green Beans $13, Fried Shrimp $18.25, Jalapeno Calamari $16, Lettuce Wraps $16 and Baby Back Ribs & Fries $20.25.

qa.q: What Mac & Cheese options are there?
qa.a: House Mac $15, Bacon Cheddar & Jalapeno $17.25, Parmesan & Mushroom $17.25, Chicken Parmesan $18.25, Melody Burger Mac $19.25 and Lobster Mac $21.50.

qa.q: What is the Melody Burger?
qa.a: Grilled Angus beef on a pretzel bun with caramelized onions, Gorgonzola, apple-smoked bacon, spinach and BBQ sauce, served with fries. It's $19.25.

qa.q: What tacos and burritos do you have?
qa.a: Tacos (2 per order) come in Shrimp $16, Salmon $16, Carnitas $14, Chicken $13, Avocado $13 and Beyond $14. Burritos are Carnitas $18.25, Steak $18.25, Chicken $17.25 and Bean & Cheese $14. There are also Nachos $15 and a Cheese Quesadilla $15.

qa.q: What sides and fries do you have?
qa.a: Gilroy Garlic Fries $6.75, Melody Fries $5.75, Onion Strings $9.75, Phat Fries $7.75, Sweet Potato Fries $7.75 and Philly Cheese Steak Fries $17.25. Cheese is +$2 on Melody Fries and Phat Fries.

qa.q: Do you have soup?
qa.a: Yes: French Onion, Tomato Bisque (cup $11, bowl $15) and Black Bean (cup $9.75, bowl $14).

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian or vegan options?
qa.a: The app menu has meat-free choices like Avocado Toast, Fried Green Beans, Avocado Tacos, Beyond Tacos and Vegan Carnitas Tacos (Tuesdays). Ask your server about ingredients.

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: Margaritas (Mango and House), Paloma, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, draft beer, Mimosa, shots and a bucket of 5 beers. Drink prices in the app are previews, so ask your server.

qa.q: Do you have breakfast or brunch?
qa.a: The website lists weekend brunch Sat–Sun, 9 AM–3 PM. The app doesn't show a brunch menu, so ask staff.

qa.q: Can I tap a drink to see it poured?
qa.a: Yes. In the Drinks section, tap a drink to watch it pour. Tapping a food item shows it served.

qa.q: Is there a way to see real photos of the food?
qa.a: Yes. Some dishes have a Real photo tag, and the Real Photos section shows real plates, like the Lobster Mac & Cheese.

qa.q: Do I need to download the app?
qa.a: No. It opens in your phone's browser. Use the link on Instagram @melodylax or scan the QR code on your table.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my home screen?
qa.a: Use your phone browser's Add to Home Screen option. It's also needed for notifications on iPhone (iOS 16.4 or newer).

qa.q: Where is my rewards card?
qa.a: Tap My Rewards Card in the app to see your gold card with your card ID, points, next reward and QR. Apple and Google Wallet buttons aren't available yet.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: The app has 12 languages. Check the language option in the app.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: I don't have kid mode details. Ask staff, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Is Melody kid friendly?
qa.a: I don't have an age policy, especially for evenings. Please call (310) 670-1994 to check before you come.

qa.q: Is there a dress code?
qa.a: I don't have dress code details. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Are dogs allowed?
qa.a: I don't have pet policy details. Please call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you have a patio?
qa.a: Yes, there's a patio. In the app you can pick Patio when you order.

qa.q: What payment cards do you take?
qa.a: Our listings show American Express, Discover, Mastercard and Visa. Ask staff about anything else.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the games?
qa.a: No. The games are free to play with or without an account. You need to join Melody Rewards to save game points once rewards are on.

qa.q: Does the app track my location?
qa.a: Only if you turn on nearby alerts and your phone allows it, and only while the app is open. Your exact location stays on your phone, and it's never sold or used for ads.

qa.q: What does the app record when I open it?
qa.a: It records the time, a short device summary, whether you opened it from your Home Screen, a random phone ID and your member ID if you joined. If location is already on, it records one approximate spot (about 1 km). It's seen only by Melody's owner and SousShift AI, and never sold.

qa.q: How do I turn off nearby alerts?
qa.a: Tap Turn off nearby alerts in the app, or switch off Location and Notifications for the app in your phone's Settings. Points you already earned stay.

qa.q: Can the rules or rewards change?
qa.a: Yes. Melody can change or end the program, point values or rewards with notice in the app. Points you've already earned stay in your balance unless the program ends.

qa.q: Is Melody in the news?
qa.a: Yes. The Los Angeles Times (Oct. 21, 2026) featured Melody in a story about the food and culture around LAX. Tap Read the story in the app.
